level_definitions.L0: One family, one task family, scale transfer or a sequence whose executable rule changed.
level_definitions.L1: One exact rule independently initialized and learned in each family has learned-factor causal gain over controls in at least two qualitatively different families.
level_definitions.L2: Pooled learned representation or state improves an unseen world over the same rule fitted independently.
level_definitions.L3: Foreign-family source data improves a target over target or support-only learning.

closest_partial_signals.HYP-0028: replicated WT-only gain with bounded local update and depth signature, but no second family and unresolved DMDc_VAR_RLS explanation
closest_partial_signals.HYP-0025: family-balanced average gain from related-data regularization but worst-family regression versus persistence
closest_partial_signals.HYP-0029: shared regularization gain but sub-threshold aggregate effect, four cell regressions and higher full cost

contract_finding: L2 or L3 is stronger than the fixed G1 minimum; failure of transferred state does not logically falsify L1, but no completed mechanism passes L1 after direct re-audit.
next_cycle: Search primary evidence for one exact independently instantiated learning rule with isolated causal gain and plausible full-cost advantage in at least two qualitatively different natural domains; deduplicate known dense, classical and supplied-interface explanations before any experiment.
